disposition_reason: The Results text gives one numeric cheese lead result (0.05 ppm) and states that milk, dessert and the other cheese results were below or near the LOQs; no tables of concentrations are printed.

study.design: Official monitoring of intra-EU milk and dairy consignments entering Turin (UVAC random sampling), 2007
study.origin: Austria, Hungary, Romania, France and Germany (EU consignments)
study.market: consignments introduced into the City of Turin, Italy
study.method: Microwave digestion (UNI EN 13805) of 7 g milk or 2 g cheese with HNO3/H2O2; GFAAS for As, Cd, Cr, Pb; flame AAS for Fe; direct mercury analyser for Hg
study.lod_text: LOQ As, Cd, Hg 0.01 mg/kg; Cr 0.05 mg/kg; Pb 0.004 mg/kg; Fe 0.2 mg/kg
study.qa: Calibration with standard solutions; no CRM or recovery reported

findings.material_label: Cheese, imported from Germany (brand-named semi-hard cheese)
findings.group: EU-origin cheese lots sampled at Turin, Germany, lot 1
findings.notes: First sample and confirmatory resample both 0.05 ppm. After the EU 1881/2006 conversion factor (9.74 kg milk per kg cheese, supplied by the producer) the authors report 0.005 ppm milk-equivalent, compliant with the 0.02 ppm milk limit. Other metals in this cheese below or near LOQ.
